correctness.rationale: L(K_{2,n}) consists of two n-cliques E_i and F_j with matching adjacency E_i--F_i and distance 2 for i!=j. E_i labels disjoint union U has size nt. F_j avoids E_j and intersects each of n-1 other E_i in at most one color, forcing r=max(0,t-n+1) colors outside U; F_j mutually disjoint forces >=nr new colors. Modular cyclic construction F_j={a_{j+s,s}:1<=s<=min(t,n-1)} ∪ {b_{j,h}:1<=h<=r}, E_i={a_{i,s}:1<=s<=t} meets every clique and cross-distance intersection requirement with exactly nt+nr palette. n=1 gives adjacent-edge 2t boundary; n=2 gives cycle/C4 4t-2. Independent tests for n<=6,t<=7 checked 42 constructions and pair intersections; analytic proof covers every n,t>=1.
